# Supported mice

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/generate-models.py — do not edit by hand. -->

Protocol data comes from [OpenRazer](https://github.com/openrazer/openrazer) (commit `477f4d6d3ab7`, 2026-10-05).

- **Verified**: tested on real hardware with DPI Switcher.
- **Untested**: should work based on OpenRazer's data. The app asks you to confirm once, and on wired mice the DPI is temporary, so unplugging resets it. [Report the result](../CONTRIBUTING.md#report-your-mouse) to get a model verified.
- **wireless**: the mouse keeps the Mac DPI until it powers off, so it can carry over to another computer.
- **saved DPI only**: the model only accepts a DPI saved to its memory, so the value also applies on other computers. The app can restore the original value.
